name: Colonial Cube Clash VA 2024

venue.name: Williamsburg Community Chapel
venue.details: Park where it says 'office'.  Go in those doors and it will be straight ahead

information:
This competition is being held in the Mid-Atlantic Region (DC, DE, MD, NJ, NY, PA, VA, WV). See the regions on [CubingUSA's website](https://cubingusa.org/regional).

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzc5NjQsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--add1bb25ae52f53ed851da134b87da94d0f8c359/Mid_Atlantic_Logo.png)

 - Join the [Tri-State Cubing Facebook group](https://www.facebook.com/groups/265800827296908/) (NJ, NY, PA)
